reading.body:
Tina Smith's recorded AI-related activity is almost entirely one bill: eleven of her fourteen events are votes on S. 2296, all but one of them cast on a single day.

The pattern is concentration, not range. Ten of those eleven votes came on 2025-10-09, covering amendments, passage, and earlier procedural motions going back to cloture on 2025-09-02. She voted Nay on the motion to proceed, Nay on cloture, Nay on the motion to table, and Nay on final passage, while splitting Yea and Nay across the individual amendments. The two cosponsorships, S. 3682 and S. 2997, are the only events here that are affirmative legislative choices rather than votes on someone else's vehicle.

For AI specifically, this record shows a senator engaging a single bill repeatedly rather than building a portfolio across many. Nothing in the data identifies what S. 2296 or either cosponsored bill would do, so no claim can be made about whether these positions favor or restrict compute, data centers, or grid buildout. The summary mentions money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, but no contribution event appears among the fourteen points, so the financial side of the record is not actually represented here.

What the data does not cover is large. There is no vote on any bill other than S. 2296, no committee action, no stated position, and no outcome for the two cosponsored bills beyond their latest status dates. Fourteen events over roughly four months describe one senator's floor behavior on one measure, and nothing more.
